messages:
Aisha: Heads up — we got a request to onboard 'Veridian-70B' (open checkpoint) for customer X. Asking for prioritization given limited dedicated capacity this quarter.
Tom: +1 to evaluate, but can we do a quick capacity/latency check first? 70B on our smallest pool will likely violate 99th pct SLO.
Priya: Agree. My quick perf sim shows ~1.8x memory vs our Atlas-40B baseline when using same batch policy. Need quant path.
Devon: Proposal: 1) 4-bit GPTQ smoke 2) run token-level latency sim (p50/p95/p99) 3) QA eval on our 10k prompt suite (safety + instruction following) 4) Canary on dedicated pool with auto-fallback to 40B compressed variant.
Aisha: That sounds reasonable. Can we add an embeddings compatibility check? customer uses reranking with embeddings.
Priya: Yes — embedding vector delta threshold: cosine avg shift <= 0.01 for top-k rerank. If >0.01, we block until we have a conversion/mapper.
Tom: Rough checklist I put together, feel free to react/edit: 
```
- Perf sim (mem/cost/latency)
- Quant options: GPTQ 4-bit, dynamic 8-bit, awq test
- Eval suite: LLamaBench-10k + customer prompts
- Embedding consistency test (cosine threshold)
- Rollout plan + fallback
- SLA impact doc
```
Devon: Nice. For quant experiments, can we parallelize AWQ + GPTQ? infra-bot: queued jobs: q1234 (gptq), q1235 (awq). ETA ~ 4h each.
Aisha: Great. Who owns the canary run? I can coordinate with Dedicated infra.
Tom: Devon can do the evals, Priya will run embedding checks, I will own perf sims and cost modeling.
Priya: Quick note — if AWQ yields similar quality but better latency, we should prefer AWQ for Dedicated (makes autoscaling simpler).
Devon: Will run evals tonight and post a compact summary mañana. If quality regression >2% on key tasks we stop.
Aisha: Decision ask: Approve prioritization to spend ~2 reserved GPU-hours and run both quant experiments? React with :thumbsup: to approve or :pause_button: to defer.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Devon: :thumbsup:
Aisha: OK all thumbs up. Devon, please post results in this thread and tag me.
Devon: Will do — starting runs now. infra-bot: canary-presign done, datasets mounted: s3://redwood-evals/veridian-70b/
ops-bot: Note — schedule window for Dedicated canary is 2026-03-21T02:00Z-06:00Z per infra maintenance calendar.
Aisha: Thanks — moving to 'in-progress' on the bring-up board. I'll update the model intake doc with checklist items we agreed.
Devon: Quick interim: GPTQ job finished, initial ppl eval looks within 1.1% of baseline on instruct tasks. AWQ running. Posting numeric table once AWQ completes.
Priya: If AWQ holds, we should add a small adapt-mapper for embeddings. I can prototype mapping script: 
```
# quick affine fit for embeddings
A = np.stack(src)
B = np.stack(tgt)
W, b = linear_regression(A, B)
```
Aisha: Perfect. Thanks team. Ping me if any red flags.
Devon: Will post results (p50/p95/p99, quality deltas, embed cosines) as separate lines here soon.
